project_short_description: A Docker image boilerplate with Smith build wiring.

__prompts__.org: GitHub org, used for the OCI image.source label
__prompts__.image_slug: image_name with underscores; used for the compose service name
__prompts__.registry: Registry the image is tagged for (no trailing slash)
__prompts__.base_image_family: Base-image family; controls user/group creation commands in the Dockerfile
__prompts__.build_tool: Parameters-file flavor: docker-bake.hcl (docker buildx bake) or compose.yaml (docker compose build)
